turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's use them. Why was Owen's mark changed before anyone called me?
I didn't come to be thanked. I asked you a question, Hale: who decided on the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
Here is my offer. I will change the zero to 70 percent today if you drop the complaint and we never mention it again.

You're offering me a mark to make a complaint go away. I'm writing that down. Seventy percent isn't the point, Hale; the zero comes off, and if you won't say why it went on, I'm going to the principal.
Nobody has to know. Do we have a deal?
"Nobody has to know." That's what you say when you've done something you don't want known. No deal, Hale. Withdraw the zero, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done.
